source: Public Azure Retail Prices API; estimates, not an invoice

assumptions.grantStartAndEnd: Must be verified separately; not inferred from free-service expiry
assumptions.freeDiskMeterEligibility: Must match managed-disk meter; unknown is paid
assumptions.registry: Basic by default; Standard only with verified applicable free meter

notes: Backup capacity increased from 50 GB to 300 GiB to preserve 7 daily / 4 weekly / 3 monthly bounded archives and account for soft deletion. At 12 GiB/archive, 14 retained + 7 soft-deleted archive-days can reach 252 GiB.
At the 50 GB transfer ceiling, add $3/month to the 25 GB scenarios.
No VM sizing change. Estimates exclude tax, paid SaaS and operator labor. Hard usage controls do not establish an exact-dollar spending guarantee.
